_comment: Render input for nomorechat's GPU client (scripts/gpu-capture.mjs passes it to `render --page-ref REF`). The page's render op receives this whole object and runs window.nmcGpu.ops.run(args). Args follow BROWSER_RUN (warmup 60, frames 300) and CAPTURE (1280x720, devicePixelRatio 1, resize cycle). The screenshot is the canvas, read after the run op resolves.
